fields.PRODUCT NAME: Handcrafted Rajasthani Ceramic Tile Wall Hook
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a touch of traditional charm to your home with this handcrafted Rajasthani ceramic tile wall hook. Featuring a vibrant hand-painted floral motif on a square ceramic tile, this piece beautifully combines utility with ethnic artistry. The sturdy iron hook with a smooth ceramic knob makes it perfect for hanging keys, towels, clothes, or accessories while enhancing your wall décor. A stylish and practical choice for any living space, blending everyday function with timeless Rajasthani craftsmanship.
